question: 招商银行同一天的收盘价是多少？
answer:
生成查询代码
SELECT
    b.ENDDATE AS `交易日期`,
    b.STOCKSNAME AS `股票名称`,
    b.STOCKCODE AS `股票代码`,
    ROUND(b.TCLOSE, 2) AS `收盘价(元)`,
    ROUND(b.TOPEN, 2) AS `开盘价(元)`,
    ROUND(b.THIGH, 2) AS `最高价(元)`,
    ROUND(b.TLOW, 2) AS `最低价(元)`,
    ROUND(b.TVOLUME/1000000, 2) AS `成交量(百万股)`,
    ROUND(b.TVALUE/100000000, 2) AS `成交额(亿元)`,
    ROUND(b.MKTCAP/100000000, 1) AS `流通市值(亿元)`,
    ROUND(b.TCAP/100000000, 1) AS `总市值(亿元)`
FROM
    GET_A_SEC_CODE a
JOIN
    ANA_STK_EXPR_IDX b
    ON a.INNER_CODE = b.INNER_CODE
WHERE
    a.SEC_SNAME LIKE '%招商银行%'
    AND b.ENDDATE = '2026-08-31'
    AND a.ISVALID = 1
ORDER BY
    b.ENDDATE DESC
LIMIT 1;
